# Chou Rotation Pick Pressure

Chou becomes more defensible when a single removed target immediately converts into territory.

## What to watch

- Look for pick windows that cash into turtle, lord, or tower.
- Avoid drafts asking Chou to be the durable first engager every fight.
- Protect the follow-up lane behind the removal.

## Why it matters

His volatility is acceptable only when the map knows what to do with the pick next.

> A clean pick matters only if the map cashes it instantly.

More on Chou: keep this read connected to fighter roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
